author: reek
body: Both are here, and the pair is the test. guarded-local is the control: it passed before this arm existed, so a regression that lost the field target would leave it proven and only guarded-field would fall back to a runtime check. The .diag pins CDX2053 rather than compilation for exactly that reason -- both still COMPILE either way, because the store's runtime check is the fallback. Only the absent proof shows it.
